desc: Try-before-you-set-up demo of Task Hub. Shows the task list, calendar and settings screens filled with built-in sample data so you can see and use the plugin without a CalDAV server. Nothing is sent anywhere and nothing on your device is changed: this build requests no permissions, has no network access, and every action that would save something reports that it is a demo instead. Install the full Task Hub to sync with your own server.
name: Task Hub Demo
author: Sparkinman
